row.title: A watch whose failure is returned and dropped is not a watch
row.body: The tick's GH-ONLY-WATCH-1 reading returned unmeasured lines for loops it could not read or dispatch, and the tick discarded them, so base-rates and open-questions loops were never dispatched through gaps of 8 to 12 hours (the only dispatches in either repository were by hand) and GitHub's cron ran them about twice a day instead of four times. Rule: every reading's inability to act is filed as an item with a probe (ghOnlyFailures into declaredItems), the same as a failed pulse.

title: A watch whose failure is returned and dropped is not a watch
